title: Stop and resume
summary: A person's stop on agents: the files chock stop and chock stop --everywhere write, the hooks that read them, and the log lines a stop leaves.
intro: A stop is a file a person writes and every chock hook reads. While it is in force, the pre-tool stop check, the git dispatcher and the MCP gateway refuse the next action of an agent in scope, and each refusal is logged. Only a person at a terminal lifts it.

boundaries.label: Every hook that judges an agent's next action

nodes.label: chock stop
nodes.card: A person stops agents in one repository: it writes .chock/stop.json (scope, reason, who as git user.email, when) and an entry in the machine registry. An agent's shell is refused, and the refusal is logged.

nodes.label: stop --everywhere
nodes.card: A person stops every agent on the machine: it writes ~/.chock/stops/_everywhere.json. --agent is refused with it: the scope is every agent.

nodes.label: chock resume
nodes.card: Person-only: it refuses an agent's shell, needs stdin and stdout to be a TTY, and asks for the repository's name to be typed. --everywhere asks for the word everywhere and lifts only the machine-wide stop.

nodes.label: .chock/stop.json
nodes.card: The repository's stop. Not committed, so a worktree has no copy of its own: the main checkout's stop reaches it.

nodes.label: Machine registry
nodes.card: ~/.chock/stops/<sha256 of the repository's realpath>.json (0o600), for a hook whose client names no project root for the session: it refuses every call of an agent in scope while any entry is in force.

nodes.label: _everywhere.json
nodes.card: ~/.chock/stops/_everywhere.json. A file there that is not a regular file, or cannot be read or parsed, refuses too.

nodes.label: Stop reader
nodes.card: Reads every stop. A file that exists but cannot be read or parsed refuses every agent. Stdlib only: gate.py and every runtime carry it.

nodes.label: Pre-tool stop check
nodes.card: chock sync wires one --stop-check entry per client, with no matcher, so the stop sees every tool call, reads included. A refused call reads stopped: <reason>. What happens when a hook cannot run is agentseam's data, listed below.

nodes.label: Git dispatcher
nodes.card: Refuses an agent's commit or push while a stop is in force; a person's passes. Only the main checkout's .chock/bin/gate.py tells an agent from a person.

nodes.label: MCP gateway
nodes.card: Refuses each tools/call while a stop reaches it, as an MCP error. It forwards initialize, tools/list and every other method.

nodes.label: Decision log
nodes.card: Each refused call is a block line with reason stopped. chock stop and chock resume each write one chock-stop line: event repo_stop or repo_resume, with scope, who and when.
